blocks.text: This Name is found in the Noble Qur'aan in ten aayaat.

The word الرأفة compassion according to Ibn Jareer 'is a higher meaning of mercy رحمة. It is general for all the creation in the world and for some of them in the Next Life.' 'Some' meaning: His believing allies and His God conscious servants. From the beneficial principles which the people of knowledge have laid down regarding the subject of understanding Allaah's Beautiful Names is that the endings of the Qur'aanic aayaat with Allaah's Beautiful Names indicate that the ruling mentioned in it is related to that Noble Name that ends the aayah. Reflecting upon that is from the greatest means of helping a servant to understand Allaah's Beautiful Names.
An example is in Allaah's saying,

On the Day when every person will be confronted with all the good he has done, and all the evil he has done, he will wish that there were a great distance between him and his evil. And Allah warns you against Himself (His Punishment) and Allah is full of Kindness to the (His) slaves.

This means that despite Allaah's severe punishment and great exemplary punishment He is indeed Compassionate with His servants. It is from His Compassion with them that He makes His servants afraid and drives them away from deviancy and corruption, so that they will be safe from their consequences and that they will be saved from their punishments. He is Compassionate and Merciful and this eases the paths of His servants to achieve good and raises their levels. It is compassion and mercy from Him that the servants are warned about the paths that lead to disliked actions. Allaah says regarding this,

And those who came after them say: "Our Lord! Forgive us and our brethren who have preceded us in Faith, and put not in our hearts any hatred against those who have believed. Our Lord! You are indeed full of kindness, Most Merciful.

This is from Allaah's mercy and compassion with His believing servants that He established a contract of faith, a religious link and a close tie of God-consciousness between them; He made the ones who came after love the ones who came before - calling to it with every goodness. What an excellent gift, how noble is the benefit that our Protector, The Compassionate, The Merciful has given as a favour.

keyPoints: Ar-Ra'oof is found in the Noble Qur'aan in ten aayaat.
According to Ibn Jareer, compassion (ra'fah) is a higher meaning of mercy; it is general for all creation in this world and for some of them (His believing, God-conscious servants) in the Next Life.
A beneficial principle: when an aayah ends with one of Allaah's Names, the ruling mentioned in it is related to that Name.
In Aali 'Imraan 3:30, it is from His Compassion that He warns His servants and makes them afraid, so they are saved from deviancy and its punishments.
From His compassion with the believers is that He established a tie of faith between them, making later generations love those who came before (Hashr 59:10).

evidence.text: And Allah warns you against Himself (His Punishment) and Allah is full of Kindness to the (His) slaves.
Our Lord! You are indeed full of kindness, Most Merciful.

recall.a: The Compassionate and Kind; compassion (ra'fah), according to Ibn Jareer, is a higher meaning of mercy.

recall.q: In how many aayaat is Ar-Ra'oof found?
What principle do the people of knowledge mention about aayaat ending with Allaah's Names?
recall.a: The ending of an aayah with one of Allaah's Names indicates that the ruling mentioned in it is related to that Name.

recall.q: How is Allaah's warning of His punishment in Aali 'Imraan 3:30 a sign of His compassion?
recall.a: From His Compassion He makes His servants afraid and drives them away from deviancy and corruption so that they are safe from their consequences and saved from their punishments.
